section.title: Subagents & task board
section.subtitle: How many levels of teammates, how many at once, turns each, whether they may ask you for approval, and the shared task board
field.allowDelegation.label: Let the model hand out work to teammates on its own
field.allowDelegation.help: With this off the subagent tool is withdrawn along with its prompt; teammates already running finish their current turn.
field.maxTeammates.label: Teammates at once per session
field.maxTeammates.help: The concurrency cap for each session; finished teammates do not count. When it is full, new work is refused outright instead of queued.
field.maxDepth.label: Recursion depth
field.maxDepth.help: 0 = only the main session can spawn teammates and a lead cannot spawn further; 1 = a lead can spawn teammates, and those teammates cannot.
field.maxTurns.label: Turn limit
field.maxTurns.help: 0 = unlimited, the teammate decides (the default). Otherwise the smaller of this and the role file's max-turns wins, and 0 in a role file also means unlimited. With a limit, the last turn gets no tools and is asked to wrap up.
field.approval.label: Whether teammates may request approval
field.approval.help: This is a ceiling: an approval setting in a role file can only be stricter, never looser.
option.approval.forbid: No: actions needing approval fail and are noted in the report
option.approval.foreground: Foreground teammates only, meaning the ones whose result is being awaited
option.approval.ask: Yes, and the approval card names the teammate
field.notify.label: How background teammates report back
option.notify.auto: The report joins the lead's next turn automatically
option.notify.quiet: Written to the session only; the model sees it on the next exchange
field.defaultModel.label: Default model for teammates
field.defaultModel.placeholder: Empty = follow the current model; format deepseek/deepseek-chat
field.defaultModel.help: A role that names a model in its role file uses that one.
field.rolesDir.label: Roles directory
field.rolesDir.help: Built-in roles: {names}. Editing files only affects teammates created afterwards.
field.newRole.label: Create a sample role
field.newRole.help: Creates starter.md in the roles directory to edit as a reference.
group.board.title: Task board
group.board.description: A shared per-session to-do list: register, claim and close; teammates and the main model see the same board.
field.board.label: Enable the shared task board (team_task tool)
field.board.help: With this off the model gets no team_task tool and no board prompt; the roster, delegation and reports keep working.
field.boardDir.label: Board folder
field.boardDir.help: One board per session (<session id>.json), so switching sessions switches boards.
field.clearBoard.label: Clear this session's board
field.clearBoard.help: Clears only the tasks of the current session; other sessions and teammate run records are untouched.
action.clearBoard: Cleared this session's board ({count} entries removed)
save.badModelFormat: Write it as “endpoint/model”, for example deepseek/deepseek-chat; leave it empty to follow the current model
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.roleWritten: Wrote {file}; edit and save it, and it can be given work
